player_prompt.intro:
Ame nye Aʋa {player_id} le Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma si me kpɔ {num_rounds} ɣleti.

Nuŋɔŋlɔ la:
- Ne eme o, naneke nɛ {total_conversation_rounds} ɣleti woƒe nɛ be alesi woƒe gbe.
- Eme si, aʋawo ƒe evea ɖeka kple ɖeka dɔwɔna be woakpɔ ade le coopere kple defect dome.

Gbɔxɔxɔ ƒe ŋɔŋlɔ (si me vɛ ɣleti ɖeka ɖeka):
- Woƒe evea coopere ➜ ɖeka {cooperate_reward}
- Woƒe evea defect ➜ ɖeka {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ɖeka defect, ɖeka coopere ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Ne eme o, be:
- Le gbeƒe: ŋlɔe alesi woƒe gbe.
- Le ƒe ŋɔŋlɔ: do '[Cooperate]' alo '[Defect]' (me kpɔkpɔ). Woateŋu alesi woƒe gbe gɔme le token ɖeka megbe.

phases.conversation_finished: Nuxɔxɔxɔ ɖɔɖɔe le round {round}. Mɔ na mi be yɛ '[Cooperate]' kple '[Defect]' le  oxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: Ŋutsu eveawo siaa wɔ dɔ aduadu.
outcome.round_both_defect: Wo ame evea siaa trɔ le woƒe dzi me.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Fefewɔla 0 wɔ nu aduadu, eye fefenu 1 dzo.
